eyebrow: Tickets as embeddings: TF-IDF then SVD
code:
# doc 1: "charge on my card was wrong"
# doc 2: "please refund the payment"
X = TfidfVectorizer().fit_transform(docs)
E = TruncatedSVD(n_components=3,
      random_state=0).fit_transform(X)
S_sparse = cosine_similarity(X)
S_dense = cosine_similarity(E)
print(S_sparse[1, 2])   # 0.0
print(S_dense[1, 2])    # 1.0 (rounded)
caption: No shared words, yet the embedding places them together.
Output of the code above: the dense version shows topic blocks.
